name: 액세서리 일관성 분석
description: Analyzes accessory rendering consistency in 비디오
algorithm: Accessory Consistency — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal consistency of accessories (glasses, earrings, hats) across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Accessory감지&추적**: Facial landmarks and object detection are used to identify accessories in each frame — glasses frames, earring positions, hat contours, and other wearable items. Each accessory is tracked across consecutive frames using optical flow and bounding box correlation.

2. **기하학적일관성분석**: The geometric properties of detected accessories (shape, aspect ratio, symmetry) are measured per frame. In authentic video, accessories maintain consistent geometry modulated only by smooth head pose changes. Deepfakes often produce frame-to-frame geometric fluctuations in accessories due to imperfect face-swapping at boundaries.

3. **텍스처&Appearance안정성**: Accessory surface textures (reflective properties of glasses lenses, metallic sheen of jewelry) are tracked. Real accessories show physically coherent appearance changes with lighting. Deepfake generators frequently fail to maintain consistent accessory rendering, producing flickering or morphing artifacts.

4. **경계일관성Check**: The edges where accessories meet skin/hair are examined. Authentic boundaries show consistent occlusion relationships and natural blending. Face-swap artifacts typically produce irregular boundary rendering — glasses frames may partially merge with skin, or earrings may appear to clip through hair.

5. **시간적이상점수 산출**: Statistical measures of accessory consistency (variance of geometric features, temporal gradient of appearance) are computed. High variance or sudden discontinuities across otherwise smooth motion sequences indicate manipulation, yielding an elevated forensic score.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through accessory consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
